subject: Supplier onboarding: EU invoice schema & portal fields for NordicGoods Ltd.
messages:
From: Ana Costa <ana.costa@nordicgoods.eu>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Onboarding & invoice format for Redwood purchase orders

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the call this morning — excited to get NordicGoods live as an approved supplier for EU shipments. To avoid PO/payment delays on our side I wanted to confirm the exact invoice fields Redwood requires for EU VAT handling.

We typically send invoices from accounts@nordicgoods.eu in the following XML layout (attached sample). Two questions:

- Do you need an EORI or VAT registration number in a specific invoice element?
- For reverse-charge shipments (Redwood billed in NL), should we include any special notation in the invoice text or a tax/line-item code?

I'll attach our onboarding form and a sample invoice. If you prefer, Laura in finance can call to walk through the XML mapping.

Best,
Ana Costa
Head of Finance — NordicGoods Ltd.
attachments: nordic_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf), sample_invoice_eu.xml (xml)

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Costa <ana.costa@nordicgoods.eu>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & invoice format for Redwood purchase orders

Ana — thanks and great to meet you on the call. Copying Laura (finance) and Ben (tax ops) so we can align on the VAT fields and mapping. A few quick notes before we dig into the XML: 

- Primary requirement: we need the supplier VAT number (EU VAT ID) and the billing/legal entity name on every invoice. Ideally these go in distinct invoice tags so our AP parser populates the VAT field.
- For reverse-charge: include the phrase "reverse charge" on the invoice body and set VAT amount to 0. Also indicate the applicable local reverse-charge article if you have it (optional but helpful).
- EORI is only required for customs; include it in the onboarding form but it does not need to be a mandatory invoice element for payments.

Can you fill the vendor onboarding form fields: legal_entity, VAT_number, EORI (if available), bank details, and a billing contact email? Laura — can you confirm if we require any additional XML attributes (e.g., invoiceTypeCode) for our parser? Ben — if you have a short checklist we can share with Nordics that would be great.

Camila
Commercial Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Ana Costa <ana.costa@nordicgoods.eu>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts@nordicgoods.eu <accounts@nordicgoods.eu>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 10:09:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Onboarding & invoice format for Redwood purchase orders

Camila / Laura / Ben — attached the completed onboarding form and a sanitized sample invoice (sample_invoice_eu.xml). Quick notes embedded in the XML:

- VAT number: EU-VAT-GB999999999 (this is a test sample) placed in <TaxRegistrationNumber>.
- For shipments where NordicGoods is not VAT-registered in the buyer's country we will mark invoice lines with <TaxCategory>RC</TaxCategory> and add "reverse charge" in <InvoiceNote>.
- Bank details included (SEPA) and billing contact is accounts@nordicgoods.eu.

If you prefer an alternate tag for VAT (e.g., <BuyerSpecifiedIdentifier>), tell us and we'll re-export. Also attaching the onboarding PDF for signatures.

On a process note: how quickly does Redwood typically approve new supplier records once the onboarding form + W9/W8-equivalent is submitted? We have a handful of orders waiting on PO activation.

Thanks,
Ana
Attachment: nordic_onboarding_form.pdf, sample_invoice_eu.xml

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Costa <ana.costa@nordicgoods.eu>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & invoice format for Redwood purchase orders

Ana — thanks for the files and the clear XML notes. A few action items and confirmations:

- SAP/AP parser: the VAT ID in <TaxRegistrationNumber> is fine; we will map that to supplier.vat_id. Please ensure the number is the canonical EU VAT format (country code + digits).
- Reverse-charge: adding <TaxCategory>RC plus a human-readable "reverse charge" note is perfect. We'll treat VAT amount = 0 and route the invoice to our EU tax team for reporting.
- Mandatory onboarding fields for approval: legal_entity, VAT_number, billing_contact_email, bank_IBAN, supplier_address, and a signed onboarding_form.pdf. Once we receive the completed PDF and confirm bank details, typical activation time is 3 business days (can be faster if everything matches).

Next steps for you:
- Please sign the attached onboarding_form.pdf and return the signed copy to accounts@nordicgoods.eu (cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai).
- If you want, Ben can run a quick edge-case check against Dutch reverse-charge rules; Ben, are you available to take a 20-minute screen-share tomorrow at 9am CET?

Once the form is signed we'll create the supplier record and push a PO test so you can validate invoice ingestion.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
phone: +44 20 5551 7788
